function_v0.doc: Write-down: burns up to `amount` of the PLUSD the pocket still holds.\nReturns what was burned.
function_v0.name: burn

function_v0.doc:
Opens the loan's pocket with the `amount` of PLUSD sPLUSD just moved
here, owned by the share holders at the end of `snapshot_ledger`.
sPLUSD passes its total supply at that ledger (the pocket cannot call
back into it mid-`carve_out`: Soroban forbids re-entry).
function_v0.name: open

function_v0.doc: Pays `holder` their share of everything released so far, by their\nsPLUSD balance at the snapshot, less what they already claimed.\nReturns what was paid.
function_v0.name: claim

function_v0.doc:
Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

# Arguments

* `e` - Access to Soroban environment.
function_v0.name: paused

function_v0.doc:
Books a recovery: up to `principal` of the held PLUSD, plus the
`interest` PLUSD the minter just minted here, become claimable.
Principal beyond what the pocket holds (the part of the loan the vault
could not cover at default) has no PLUSD here to release. Returns the
principal released, which `unrelease` must be given back.
function_v0.name: release

function_v0.doc: What `claim` would pay `holder` now: `released_total \xc3\x97\nbalance_at(holder, snapshot) / supply_at_snapshot \xe2\x88\x92 claimed`.
function_v0.name: claimable

function_v0.doc:
Returns `Some(Address)` if ownership is set, or `None` if ownership has
been renounced.

# Arguments

* `e` - Access to the Soroban environment.
function_v0.name: get_owner

function_v0.doc:
Reverses a `release`: `principal` (as `release` returned it) goes back
to held and the `interest` PLUSD is burned. Refused once any holder
has claimed: entitlements are pro-rata of `released_total`, so
shrinking it after a claim lets earlier claimers keep the excess and
later claims take it from `held`.
function_v0.name: unrelease

function_v0.doc:
* `owner` - The access-manager.
* `staked_plusd` - The sPLUSD vault: opens pockets, and its balance
history decides the claims. Its underlying asset is taken as PLUSD.
* `loan_registry` - Burns from pockets on write-down.
* `minter` - Releases recoveries.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc:
Accepts a pending ownership transfer.

# Arguments

* `e` - Access to the Soroban environment.

# Errors

* [`crate::role_transfer::RoleTransferError::NoPendingTransfer`] - If
there is no pending transfer to accept.

# Events

* topics - `["ownership_transfer_completed"]`
* data - `[new_owner: Address]`
function_v0.name: accept_ownership

function_v0.doc:
Renounces ownership of the contract.

Permanently removes the owner, disabling all functions gated by
`#[only_owner]`.

# Arguments

* `e` - Access to the Soroban environment.

# Errors

* [`OwnableError::TransferInProgress`] - If there is a pending ownership
transfer.
* [`OwnableError::OwnerNotSet`] - If the owner is not set.

# Notes

* Authorization for the current owner is required.
function_v0.name: renounce_ownership

function_v0.doc:
Initiates a 2-step ownership transfer to a new address.

Requires authorization from the current owner. The new owner must later
call `accept_ownership()` to complete the transfer.

# Arguments

* `e` - Access to the Soroban environment.
* `new_owner` - The proposed new owner.
* `live_until_ledger` - Ledger number until which the new owner can
accept. A value of `0` cancels any pending transfer.

# Errors

* [`OwnableError::OwnerNotSet`] - If the owner is not set.
* [`crate::role_transfer::RoleTransferError::NoPendingTransfer`] - If
trying to cancel a transfer that doesn't exist.
* [`crate::role_transfer::RoleTransferError::InvalidLiveUntilLedger`] -
If the specified ledger is in the past.
* [`crate::role_transfer::RoleTransferError::InvalidPendingAccount`] -
If the specified pending account is not the same as the provided `new`
address.

# Notes

* Authorization for the current owner is required.
function_v0.name: transfer_ownership
